prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE square, opaque standalone illustration for the game class card 浪掷风吟. No card border, text, lettering, watermark, or UI. This is a fresh composition.

INPUT ROLES: Images 1, 2 and 3 are DRAWING-STYLE references ONLY: image 1 blue-and-gold portrait establishes broad opaque strokes and coherent locks; image 2 dark-coat portrait establishes economical cloth volumes; image 3 brown-haired portrait establishes anime eyes and restrained face marks. Borrow painting grammar, not their character identities, hats, outfits or props. Image 4 is ONLY the character design reference for Xingyue; borrow her identity and clothing, not the standing pose, white blank backdrop or lantern. Do not copy any watermark.

SCENE AND ACTION: Xingyue is chanting a wind song as the river behind her and a fierce gale revolve around her. Medium-wide three-quarter-body composition, subtly low camera, her readable face near the upper central area; she occupies about two thirds of the square height. Torso turned slightly, chin lifted, mouth visibly open in a small natural singing shape, warm gold eyes half-open, serene and focused. Both arms spread in an expressive, natural conducting gesture, one palm lifted near shoulder height, the other extended lower to the side, fingers relaxed and anatomically clear. Long braid, teal cape and layered skirt all sweep along the same swirling wind direction. A REAL river flows from the distance BEHIND her, curves around her back, then its broad blue-green water surface is lifted into one powerful circling bank of water; a portion passes at the lower foreground to establish depth. Keep the rear river course visibly connected to the suspended curving water, so this reads as a river bending around her rather than abstract magic ribbons. Fierce wind is visible through a few broad pale-gray sweeping curved strokes, bent cape and hair, and sparse spray. River and wind form two or three readable large interlocking arcs around her, with most of the flow behind her shoulders and both sides. Leave her face, mouth and hands unobstructed. Environment consists of economical slate-gray riverbank silhouettes and cool gray cloud masses, with plenty of quiet areas. Large forms, not detailed scenery. No extra characters, lantern, staff, instruments, giant moon, runes, spell circles or glowing particle clouds.

CHARACTER: adult anime woman Xingyue in her normal priest form. Pale cream-gold very long hair with thick straight blunt bangs, side braid feeding a low thick plait extending far down and now swept outward by wind. Warm golden eyes. A white crescent moon hairpin clipped flat into the hair at the top of her head just above the bangs, slightly off-center to the viewer's right, tilted, resting against the hair (not floating, not a halo); white C-shape with tips toward upper right. White priest dress, modest small high collar with gold neck ring, small gold four-point star brooch, broad subdued gold trim, layered white skirt with teal underlayer. Deep teal-green short shoulder cape with gold edging. Dark half-finger wrist guards with natural skin-colored exposed fingers. Preserve these identity anchors while changing the pose. No silver hair, purple eyes or black-purple shadow form.

STYLE: hand-painted anime illustration built from large opaque color masses and a limited set of broad directional curved or elongated strokes. Clear grouped shadows and decisive handmade edges, with a few subtle gentle skin transitions. Stroke shape communicates the turn of a form. Keep selective overlaps, broken stroke endings and expressive coverage, surrounded by quieter areas. Do not flatten every interior into uniform solid fill; do not cover every surface in brush texture.
HAIR: organize the cream-gold braid, bangs and windblown hair into coherent substantial locks and grouped masses. Broad curved forms, quiet base-color regions, one or a few broad shadow turns and short irregular opaque highlight swaths. A few deliberate tapered ends and fine contour accents are enough. Avoid tiny facets, needle-tipped micro-locks, pale scratches, strand networks and dense flyaways.
FACE: unmistakable anime proportions, clear expressive upper-lid shapes, simple golden iris masses and few crisp highlights. Economical nose and open chanting mouth, broad clean cheek planes. Preserve readable bangs cast shadow, small nose underside plane, under-jaw shadow and neck turn. Selective tapered colored line accents explain anatomy. Restrained warm/cool midtone turns, no polished semi-realistic beauty shading.
BODY AND CLOTH: principal broad fold planes follow shoulders, chest, elbow joints and torso. Elongated or curved opaque strokes and only a few selective crease and contour accents at collars, seams and major tension points. Broad midtone turns connect volume. Large quiet white dress and deep teal cape areas remain. Hands are readable with economical anatomy. Avoid triangular mosaics and dense wrinkle networks.
WATER AND WIND: construct water using substantial continuous curved blue-green and gray shapes with only a few broad ivory foam marks and broken opaque strokes following flow. Matte painterly color, no glassy 3D water or photographic droplet rendering. Wind and clouds use broad simplified swept masses, not thousands of string-like filaments. Maintain convincing foreground/background overlap.
COLOR: mostly muted colored grays, cream white, slate gray, deep teal and subdued warm gold. Richer turquoise concentrated in the river's turning edge and warm gold in the eyes. Grouped light and shadow, clear warm face/cool river relationship. No full-image saturated cyan or giant rim glow.
DETAIL HIERARCHY: face/eyes and chanting gestures receive selective clarity; clothing and surroundings are economical. Match supplied style references' confident simplified finish. Avoid photorealism, glossy 3D, airbrushed commercial splash art, all-over grain/canvas filters, tiny angular facet noise, excessive rim glow, vector outlines and decorative clutter.
scope: 独立卡面候选；运行资产另有会话占用，未替换
